data.one_liner: Supabase connector for the Brick data persistence library.
data.what_it_does: Connects the Brick data persistence framework to Supabase, providing annotations, adapters, models, and providers to handle serialization, querying, and realtime data.
use_when: You are already using Brick as your data persistence layer and want to integrate Supabase.
You need structured models with annotations for Supabase tables, fields, and foreign keys.
avoid_when: You are building a standard app using the official Supabase Flutter client directly without Brick.
Your project does not use the Brick persistence ecosystem.
strengths: Seamless integration with Brick's querying and offline-first ecosystem.
Built-in annotations for table mapping, field renaming, and foreign key relations.
Includes testing utilities and mock servers for Supabase requests.
weaknesses: Does not support all Supabase filtering methods.
Does not support nested List types or many-to-many associations directly.
Tied strictly to the Brick persistence architecture.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding brick_supabase and configuring code generation along with Supabase initialization.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use the official, direct Supabase client without the overhead and abstraction of the Brick framework.
